map.支持逗号、空格、换行分隔的一批数字: Accepts a batch of numbers separated by commas, spaces or line breaks
map.自动排序后定位中间值: Sorts automatically then locates the middle value
map.偶数个数据时取中间两数平均值: With an even number of data points take the average of the two middle values

map.与均值、四分位数可配合分析: Can be analyzed together with the mean and quartiles

map.数据分布对称看均值，偏态或有离群值看中位数更稳健。: Use the mean for symmetric distributions, and the median for skewed data or data with outliers as it is more robust.
